prs.title: fix: remove unsupported excludeFromTabOrder from Select props
prs.author: UditDewan
prs.body:
Closes #7221

## Summary

**Intent:** `Select` (and `useSelect` / the S2 and v3 `Picker`s built on it) should not advertise props that do nothing.

The issue reported that `autoFocus` and `excludeFromTabOrder` had no effect on `Select`. `autoFocus` (and the `autoComplete` passthrough mentioned in the follow-up comments) has since been wired through to the trigger and `HiddenSelect`, so the remaining part is `excludeFromTabOrder`. As noted in the [maintainer comment](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/7221#issuecomment-2430677896), it was never intended to be part of the Select API and should be removed from the types.

**Change:** `AriaSelectProps` now extends `Omit<FocusableDOMProps, 'excludeFromTabOrder'>` instead of `FocusableDOMProps`. This is the same approach used when the prop was removed from the slider thumb in #6737. Nothing reads the prop at runtime, so this is a types-only change. The RAC `SelectProps`, S2 `Picker`, and v3 `Picker` all derive from `AriaSelectProps`, so it drops out of their types and generated docs too.
